info.name: Refinitiv Data Platform (RDP) APIs Authentication News API

params.name: query
params.description: The news search query string supporting keyword search and advanced query syntax.

params.name: count
params.description: Maximum number of headlines to return.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor for retrieving the next page of results.

items.docs: Retrieves news headlines matching the specified query criteria. Supports filtering by topic, instrument, date range, and other parameters. Returns headline text, timestamp, and story identifiers.

params.name: storyId
params.description: The unique identifier of the news story.

items.docs: Retrieves the full text and metadata for a specific news story identified by its story ID.
